description: Main + quickadd window permissions - minimal set, extend deliberately. Window perms: custom titlebar (decorations:false) needs drag + minimize/maximize/close; hide for the Summon toggle and closing quickadd; position/size/monitors for window-state persistence. Global-shortcut: Summon / Global Quick Add / optional Pinned+Search registration. Event: the quickadd window hands new todos to main. Updater+process: signed live updates with relaunch. Opener: web links in descriptions + the About dialog use the default url scheme scope (http/https/mailto/tel); open-path needs an open scope because the paths ARE the point of the feature - the user's own file/folder links and the data/backup folders next to the exe, none of which can be enumerated at build time. FS: the read/write commands are enabled but their scope stays EMPTY - JSON import/export grants exactly the file the user picked in the native dialog, at runtime (commands::fs_allow_picked).
